text: Grupo Bimbo, S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1945 when 'Six entrepreneurs in Mexico City, led by Lorenzo Servitje, founded Panificación Bimbo alongside 34 associates.' Per its 2025 Integrated Annual Report, the founding Servitje family remains prominent in its governance, including chairman Daniel Servitje and directors Luis Jorba Servitje, Roberto Mauricio Servitje Labarrere and María del Pilar Mariscal Servitje.

source.name: Grupo Bimbo, 2025 Integrated Annual Report ("Celebrating What Brings Us Together")
